groups.sentence: Instructors restrict or prohibit AI use in beginner and foundational courses where students are developing basic skills.
Students are told that this course requires developing fundamental skills and knowledge without AI.
Novices cannot judge AI output because they lack the fundamentals to recognize errors.
Students must learn the basics first to benefit from AI later and to succeed long-term.
Courses and beginners need foundational skill development without AI, which unrestricted AI use can hinder.
Students master fundamentals and use AI only for tasks suited to their learning level.
